title: No-results empty state with Clear filters appears in every display
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on the Work Orders build under test with Work Orders view permission; the Board View and Tech View display options are on.
  2. The current location has at least 3 lead technicians shown as groups/columns (a technician is eligible when they are Clockable, Active, and their role is not Office or Time Clock User).
  3. Via New Work Order, create several work orders and set a Lead Technician on each, spread across the technicians with some left Unassigned; then open the Work Orders page.
custom_steps:
1. Apply filters that match no work orders.
  2. View the result in List.
  3. Switch to Tech View.
  4. Switch to Board View.
  5. In each, read the empty-state message and confirm a Clear filters action is present.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • When filters match nothing, every display shows the existing "No work orders match your filters" empty state with a Clear filters action.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options). Story reference: SV-10044 — Story 1 Switch between display options. Spec: Confluence page 845185030 “Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options (Draft Spec)”, Draft v0.9, requirement(s) S1-N1 (read 23 Sep 2026). Review decisions/answers: Confluence page 853901313 where cited. Source-verified on 23 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-N1: “When filters return no results, show the existing List empty state and Clear filters action in every display: “No work orders match your filters”.”
